MEFTACARD Studio / Website design

Website design that turns visitors into customers

A website is usually the first place a customer checks before calling you. If it loads slowly, looks dated or is hard to use on a phone, they leave and call a competitor instead. We design business websites, product catalogs and online stores that are fast, clear and built to bring in enquiries.

Every site we build works in Arabic and English from the first day, with right-to-left Arabic layouts designed properly rather than flipped automatically. You get a fixed price and a fixed launch date, and you own everything we build: the code, the design files, the domain and the hosting account.

What our website design service includes

Custom design, not a template

A layout designed around your business, your customers and what you want them to do, with your brand colours and typography.

Arabic and English versions

Separate pages for each language, correct right-to-left design for Arabic and the language settings Google needs to show the right version.

Mobile-first and fast

Most visitors in the region arrive on a phone, often on a weak connection. We design for small screens first and keep pages light.

Built to rank on Google

Clean structure, page titles, descriptions, structured data and Search Console set up before launch, so the site can be found.

Ways to contact you everywhere

WhatsApp, Telegram, call and quote-request buttons placed where customers look for them, so interest turns into conversations.

Training and handover

We show your team how to update text, photos and products, and hand over every login and file.

Types of websites we design

Corporate website design

A company website that presents who you are, what you do and why buyers should trust you, with clear service pages, team, certifications and contact routes. Built for procurement teams, partners and investors as much as for customers.

Responsive web design

Every site we build adapts to phones, tablets and desktops. We design the mobile layout first, because most visitors in Iraq, Dubai, Saudi Arabia and Oman arrive on a phone, then expand it for larger screens.

E-commerce website design

Online stores with product pages, search, cart and checkout, connected to local payment methods such as Mada, KNET, BenefitPay, ZainCash or card payments, plus WhatsApp ordering where customers prefer it.

Landing page design

Focused single pages for a campaign, product launch or advertising, with one clear goal and a short form or WhatsApp button. Ideal when you run Google or Instagram ads and need a page that converts.

UI/UX design

User research, user flows, wireframes and interface design for portals, dashboards and web apps, tested with real users before development starts.

How a website project works

  1. Discovery call

    A video call to understand your business, your customers and your goals. We agree scope, price and launch date in writing.

  2. Design

    We share the homepage and key page designs online. You comment, we refine, and nothing is built until you approve.

  3. Build

    We build the site in both languages, add your content and connect contact forms, WhatsApp and analytics.

  4. Launch and support

    We test on real phones, launch, submit the site to Google and support you after launch.

Common website design mistakes we fix

Designing for desktop only

A layout that looks good on a large monitor but breaks on a phone loses most of its visitors. We test every page on real devices.

Machine-translated Arabic

Automatic translation on the same URL reads badly and hurts rankings in both languages. We write Arabic properly and give it its own pages.

No clear next step

Visitors should always see how to contact you. Many sites hide the phone number or WhatsApp in the footer.

Heavy images and sliders

Large uncompressed images and auto-playing sliders make pages slow, especially on mobile data. We optimise every image.

Agency keeps the accounts

Some cheap offers keep the domain or hosting in the agency name. Everything we set up is registered to you.

How much does website design cost?

Website design is included in all three packages. The Local package at $1,250 covers a site of up to six pages for businesses that need to be found locally. Trade & Export at $2,250 adds a product catalog, a third language and quote requests. Enterprise, from $25,000, covers corporate platforms with portals, apps and AI agents. Every price is fixed and paid in Tether (USDT).

What affects the price of a website

  • Number of unique page layouts, not just the number of pages
  • Languages: Arabic, English and any additional language
  • Online store, booking or portal features
  • Integrations with payment, CRM, ERP or WhatsApp
  • Who writes the content and whether photography is needed

Questions

How long does it take to design a website?

A local business site usually launches in about 14 days, a catalog site in about 30 days, and an enterprise platform in 12 to 16 weeks, depending on content and approvals.

Do I need to provide the content?

You provide the facts about your business, prices and photos where you have them. We write and structure the page text, and can arrange photography or illustrations if needed.

Will I be able to edit the site myself?

Yes. We build on an easy content system and train your team to update text, images and products.

Do you redesign existing websites?

Yes. We can redesign your current site while keeping your existing Google rankings, by carrying over important pages and setting up redirects.

Can you build an online store?

Yes. Online stores are part of the Trade & Export and Enterprise packages, with local payment methods for your country.

Who owns the website?

You do, from day one: code, design files, domain, hosting and analytics are registered to your company.

What is responsive web design?

A design that automatically adapts to every screen size, from phones to large monitors, so visitors get a good experience on any device. All our sites are responsive.

Do you design WordPress websites?

Yes. WordPress is a good choice for most business sites because it is easy to edit. We also build custom sites when a project needs it.

Can you design a landing page for my ads?

Yes. Landing pages are designed around one goal, such as a call or a WhatsApp message, and connected to your analytics so you can measure ad results.

Is the design affordable for small businesses?

Yes. The Local package at $1,250 is a fixed price designed for shops, clinics and service businesses.
